description: No key needed. Emails the person a link to create their free SVGMill account (or to sign in, if they have one) and returns a test-mode API key at once (free, watermarked results, no credits; it ends when the link is clicked, or after 24 hours). New accounts get 5 free credits when the person clicks the link; the page it opens shows their live API key. Disposable addresses are refused. Free.
